audit: Compared to the previous pinned Miri source: fetch_store, store_impl, load_impl, thread_created, clock synchronization and SC bookkeeping are unchanged; the data-race changes are identifier renames. Weak-memory buffer indexing now uses get_pos/get_mut_pos with the same position. The range map additionally rejects zero-sized inserts; atomic accesses in this projection are nonzero. The previous selector-rules.json remains historical evidence for its older source pin.
